plan.summary: The sync no longer visits archived projects. `syncAll` now skips any project where `project.archived` is true. Skipped projects are not synced and do not count in the returned total.
plan.riskRationale: One guard condition in a loop. It changes which projects are synced, but the change is small and local.
plan.storyArc: One change: `syncAll` skips archived projects before calling `syncProject`. The returned count only includes projects that were synced.

topics.title: Skip archived projects in syncAll
topics.narrativeBrief: What does syncAll do with archived projects now? Check that `continue` runs before `syncProject` and before `synced++`, so skipped projects are not counted. Verify that `Project` has an `archived` field.
